title: CmdPal: fix two hangs in top-level queries

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The current revision addresses the reviewed command ownership and repeated-property-fetch paths. `UpdateCommand` unwraps recent rows before selecting the host-owned top-level command view-model, and `InitializeOwnedCommandProperties` avoids reinitializing borrowed commands. The replacement path removes the prior handler before subscribing again. Default context-item titles now use the cached command name rather than fetching it again from the extension command.

The new lifecycle tests cover borrowed top-level/recent rows, replacement and handler cleanup. They were inspected, not independently executed. This assessment is based on the current source and the accumulated findings; it does not certify runtime hang resolution or a passing product build.

No additional code change is requested by this focused assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.
